scope: 顶部共用引用：页面、章节、设定

protocol.capabilities: Only declared updateModelContext.text and/or structuredContent; no experimental fallback

implementation.web_default: ReferenceLink renders the original Router Link, classes and destinations; only the App runtime intercepts clicks. Default TextCandidates messages and preview behavior are retained. No shared CSS changes.
implementation.ordering: One writer per App serializes requests and coalesces queued clicks. Only the latest selection acknowledgement reports success. Timeout drops queued updates and reports uncertainty.
implementation.acknowledgement: A valid empty result is treated as host acceptance, not proof that the next model turn consumed context. JSON-RPC errors, isError, malformed results, missing capabilities and timeouts report failure/uncertainty.
implementation.writes: No ui/message, navigation, candidate application or write_app_resource is initiated by these controls.

checks.build: pnpm --dir web build; final pnpm --dir web build:app after formatting

browser_simulated_host.facts: Synthetic REST data and simulated host replies; actual compiled internal/textmcp/appdist/review.html loaded in an iframe.
